mechanism: Methylphenidate increases norepinephrine and dopamine release while isocarboxazid inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome through additive sympathomimetic and monoaminergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring of blood pressure, heart rate, and mental status, and ensure adequate washout period between medications.
